lines.label: Part 1
lines.text: Dig snowy dig sites in the spawn / starting trenches.

lines.label: Part 2
lines.text: Dig snowy dig sites around the middle / Excavation area.

lines.label: Part 3
lines.text: Dig snowy dig sites around the Church area.

lines.label: Blue Record
lines.text: Check the three spawn points inside the Tank Station by Generator 2.

lines.label: Crystal
lines.text: Take the blue record and Gramophone to the Ice Tunnel by Generator 6, enter the Crazy Place, and collect the blue crystal.

lines.label: Build
lines.text: Use the blue pedestal beneath the Excavation Site.
Return through the Ice Tunnel and enter the Crazy Place with the Ice Staff.
Use the code chart to match the blue-dot pillar symbol to the correct ceiling stone.
Shoot each matching ceiling stone with the Ice Staff until the puzzle completes.
Find all three gravestones on the main map, freeze each one with the Ice Staff, then shoot the frozen stone with a normal bullet weapon to break it.
At the Excavation Site, use the four levers to align every ring to BLUE.
Go below the rings and shoot the blue orb with the Ice Staff.
Return to the Crazy Place and place the Ice Staff on the blue pedestal.
Kill zombies around the pedestal until the staff is fully charged, then pick it up.

lines.label: Part 1
lines.text: Activate all six generators, then collect the staff part from the reward chest beside Generator 6.

lines.label: Part 2
lines.text: Kill the first Panzer Soldat (normally Round 8) and pick up the part it drops.

lines.label: Part 3
lines.text: After the church path is open, shoot down the orange glowing plane and collect the fallen part near the Excavation mound.

lines.label: Red Record
lines.text: Check its three spawn points in the Church / Generator 6 area.

lines.label: Crystal
lines.text: Take the red record and Gramophone to the Fire Tunnel near spawn, enter the Crazy Place, and collect the red crystal.

lines.label: Build
lines.text: Use the red pedestal beneath the Excavation Site.
In the Crazy Place, kill zombies on the metal grates beside the Fire area until all four fire cauldrons are lit.
Read the illuminated fire symbols and use the code chart to translate them into the numbered torches in the Church.
Go to the Church and shoot the matching numbered torches with the Fire Staff before the puzzle resets.
At the Excavation Site, use the four levers to align every ring to RED.
Go below the rings and shoot the red orb with the Fire Staff.
Return to the Crazy Place and place the Fire Staff on the red pedestal.
Kill zombies around the pedestal until the staff is fully charged, then pick it up.

lines.label: Part 1
lines.text: Enter Thor, the robot that walks through the spawn-side trenches.

lines.label: Part 2
lines.text: Enter Odin, the robot that crosses the middle / Excavation area.

lines.label: Part 3
lines.text: Enter Freya, the robot that walks through the Church area.

lines.label: Yellow Record
lines.text: Check the Generator 5 area, including Stamin-Up and the Lightning Tunnel entrance.

lines.label: Crystal
lines.text: Take the yellow record and Gramophone to the Wind Tunnel near Generator 4, enter the Crazy Place, and collect the yellow crystal.

lines.label: Build
lines.text: Use the yellow pedestal beneath the Excavation Site.
In the Crazy Place, shoot the four ceiling rings with the Wind Staff until the symbols match the Wind puzzle code.
Return to the main map and use the Wind Staff on all three smoking chimneys so their smoke points toward the Excavation Site.
At the Excavation Site, use the four levers to align every ring to YELLOW.
Go below the rings and shoot the yellow orb with the Wind Staff.
Return to the Crazy Place and place the Wind Staff on the yellow pedestal.
Kill zombies around the pedestal until the staff is fully charged, then pick it up.

lines.label: Part 1
lines.text: Church → Gen 2, jump right after Generator 4.

lines.label: Part 2
lines.text: Gen 2 → Church, jump left onto Excavation scaffolding.

lines.label: Part 3
lines.text: Gen 2 → Church, jump right just before Church.

lines.label: Purple Record
lines.text: Generator 4 / Jug / Wind Tunnel area.

lines.label: Crystal
lines.text: Open the Lightning Tunnel beside Generator 5 with the Gramophone + purple record, then grab the purple crystal in the Crazy Place.

lines.label: Build
lines.text: Under Excavation.
Set the seven switches using the dials below.

lines.label: Excavation
lines.text: line all four rings purple → shoot the orb with the Lightning Staff.
Place the staff on the purple Crazy Place pedestal → kill zombies to fill it with souls.

_note: Captured from the four Origins staff .tsx pages at 0f44766 (before the Phase 2 redesign). The composite piano-code line is stored as its three chords.
